title: Firelight Barn Dinner Theater

services.name: Ticket
services.desc: Experience all five of Mama's Wranglers' spectacular 2026 shows with our exclusive Season Ticket Package! This package includes admission to all five performances: "Cue the Country" (starting January 2026), "Jukebox Jams" (starting March 2026), "Hollywood Hits" (starting June 2026), "Who's the Star" (starting August 2026), and "Oh Holy Night, Y'all" (starting November 2026).Please note that season tickets are valid only for Mama's Wranglers' shows and cannot be used for guest artists or special events. Available with or without food options to suit your preferences, this package is the perfect way to enjoy a full year of unforgettable entertainment at the Firelight

blurb: Just a short drive from the Strip, the Firelight Barn Dinner Theater is home to the #1 western show in the Las Vegas area. Come enjoy our family-friendly shows, featuring country western favorites, old-time rock n’ roll, classic movie hits, and a variety of guest artists.
